content:
maria_g: Heads up: rolling prod deploy started for service inference-gateway. Canary (region-us-east-1) shows elevated 5xxs and timeouts after ~10% traffic. Pausing rollout via console but need oncall to triage. @tilly_oncall
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: canary-5xx-spike for deploy d-9812. Symptoms: 502/504 and increased tail latency. Impact: ~12% of canary users. Runbook suggests flip kill-switch or manual rollback.
tilly_oncall: On it. Reached out to infra. Can you paste a sample log/trace and the canary flag name?
maria_g: Flag is feature.deploy_inference_gateway_canary. I paused rollout at 20% traffic. Example trace snippet:
```json
{"req_id":"abc123","error":"kv cache miss -> OOM?","latency_ms":1234}
```
Also seeing k8s pods in canary with OOMKilled on gpu nodes.
kevin: If pods are OOMKilled it's probably the model exceeding node memory. Recommend immediate kill-switch flip to drain canary traffic, then manual rollback to previous stable. @josh_m can you flip the flag? I will prep the rollback steps.
josh_m: Flipping flag now: `./infra-cli flag flip feature.deploy_inference_gateway_canary off --dry=false` -> done :white_check_mark:
Traffic dropped to 0% for canary per console.
incident-bot: Action logged: flag flip by josh_m. Telemetry shows canary traffic -> 0%.
tilly_oncall: Quick customer impact check: roughly 1.8% of total requests got 502/504 since deploy start. No major customer complaints yet but error budget is taking a hit. Product asked to hold off public notice until rollback confirmation. @maria_g
maria_g: Product is aware and prefers a rollback confirmation before any external comms. Kevin, what's the manual rollback plan?
kevin: Manual rollback plan:
- Step 1: Drain remaining canary pods: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-gateway-canary --replicas=0`
- Step 2: Promote previous stable image: `kubectl -n prod set image deployment/inference-gateway stable=registry/redwood/inference:stable-20260310`
- Step 3: Monitor SLOs and logs for 15m; if healthy, keep stable, otherwise roll forward.
I'll run Step 2 now.
kevin: Running promotion... `kubectl -n prod set image ...` -> ok, new stable pods coming up and passing readiness.
josh_m: Cleared prefetch cache and adjusted batch size for stable to avoid cache blowups: `POST /admin/config` with reduced batch_size.
tilly_oncall: SLOs trending back to normal. 5xx rate falling from ~2.1% -> 0.05% over the last 8 minutes. No new OOMs observed. Starting verification checklist.
maria_g: Triggering smoke tests (chat generation, embeddings, low-latency paths).
maria_g: Smoke tests green across endpoints; latencies within baseline. Marking rollback complete from deploy perspective.
tilly_oncall: Documenting impact: affected cohort ~12% canary for ~18 minutes, ~1.8% of total requests. No persistent data loss. Recommend RCA and postmortem focusing on model artifact size and deploy validation gaps.
kevin: Agreed. Follow-ups:
- Block same model artifact on gpu-node pool until validated
- Add pre-deploy check for model memory footprint and estimated runtime memory
- Improve autoscaler OOM detection to cut canary traffic earlier
josh_m: Will add an artifact size gate to the deploy pipeline and a canary health-check looking for OOM patterns.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident resolved by tilly_oncall. Timeline summary:
- 12:45 deploy started
- 12:53 canary 5xx spike detected
- 12:57 flag flipped to stop canary (josh_m)
- 13:05 manual rollback promoted (kevin)
- 13:22 smoke tests green
- 13:25 incident closed
Follow-up: create postmortem and assign to ENG-ML + ENG-PLATFORM.
tilly_oncall: Handing off 24h monitoring to next oncall rotation and filing follow-up tasks in tracker.
maria_g: Thanks all for fast coordination. I'll attach logs/traces to the ticket and add the smoke test output. :thumbsup:
